title: The Library
description: My very first fullstack web application that allows users to search for books within the warhammer 40k universe. It features a user-friendly interfce and many tools, such as book rating, summaries and quote saving.

title: The Wild Oasis
description: A Fullstack web application from the Jonas Schmedtmann React course.  A made up hotel webside where users can book a cabin, edit and delete their bookings.

title: The Wild Oasis - Dashboard
description: A suplementary dashboard page for the Wild Oasis hotel website. It features a calendar, a statistics page which takes in data from the reservations made over at teh wild oasis page, and allows for easy handling of reservartions.

title: What to Watch . In progress!
description: A mobile app that allows users to search for movies and series and save them to their own custom lists. It also features an option to get suggested random movies, when one does not know what to watch.

title: Lynq - In progress!
description: A fullstack application, co-devveloped with Filip Haellgren. The application is a communications platform like discord, with steam integration to allow easy access to friends and game sessions.
